summary.text: In 2026 remarks, Thomas Keane described AI as already transforming clinical care and performing tasks such as note-taking and administrative work. He said HHS's approach to the heterogeneous AI field must be nuanced, while describing the administration as taking an AI-forward, “try-first” approach. Keane described ONC's RFI and HTI-5 proposed rule as efforts to accelerate AI use in clinical care and enable AI-enabled interoperability while reducing regulatory burden. He said the goal is to improve health care access, affordability, and outcomes through technology including AI.
